content.title: Can the City perform maintenance near the irrigation ditch by my house?
content.summary: The City does not complete maintenance along irrigation ditches. Residents interested in completing fire mitigation or other maintenance along ditches must obtain permission from and coordinate with the ditch company and underlying property owner. *See FAQ about how to contact ditch companies.
